package.name: superdex_ros2_msgs
package.description: Message definitions for SuperDex state that has no standard ROS equivalent. Currently just contacts. This is a separate package from superdex_ros2 out of necessity, not taste: superdex_ros2 is ament_python, and an ament_python package cannot run rosidl, so it cannot generate messages. Interface packages are conventionally split out anyway -- a consumer that only needs to subscribe then depends on the messages without pulling in the simulator or its pip dependencies.
